calories-burned-calculator.question: What is a MET value?
calories-burned-calculator.answer: MET (Metabolic Equivalent of Task) measures the ratio of working metabolic rate relative to resting energy expenditure.

healthy-weight-calculator.title: Healthy Weight Calculator
healthy-weight-calculator.description: Find your healthy weight range and ideal target weight based on height and BMI standards.
healthy-weight-calculator.how: Enter current height and weight to compare against World Health Organization adult healthy boundaries.
healthy-weight-calculator.limits: Thresholds apply to adults aged 20 and older and do not substitute for comprehensive metabolic clinical exams.
healthy-weight-calculator.question: What BMI range is recognized as healthy weight?
healthy-weight-calculator.answer: A BMI between 18.5 and 24.9 is recognized globally as the standard healthy adult weight range.

heart-rate-calculator.title: Heart Rate Calculator
heart-rate-calculator.description: Convert manual pulse counts to BPM and calculate target training heart rate zones.
heart-rate-calculator.how: Count your radial or carotid pulse over 15, 30, or 60 seconds to compute beats per minute and target aerobic zones.
heart-rate-calculator.limits: Age-predicted maximal heart rate equations carry standard deviations of 10 to 12 beats per minute.
heart-rate-calculator.question: How does resting heart rate relate to cardiovascular fitness?
heart-rate-calculator.answer: Higher aerobic conditioning generally lowers resting heart rate by increasing cardiac stroke volume.

ideal-weight-calculator.title: Ideal Weight Calculator
ideal-weight-calculator.description: Calculate your ideal body weight using Robinson, Miller, Devine, and Hamwi formulas.
ideal-weight-calculator.how: Select gender and enter height to compare benchmark calculations across four validated clinical equations.
ideal-weight-calculator.limits: Formulas produce population statistical approximations and do not consider individual frame breadth or athletic muscularity.
ideal-weight-calculator.question: Why do the four formulas yield slightly different results?
ideal-weight-calculator.answer: Each formula was derived from independent clinical research cohorts with varying historical base heights and baselines.

lean-body-mass-calculator.title: Lean Body Mass Calculator
lean-body-mass-calculator.description: Calculate your lean body mass and fat mass based on body weight and fat percentage.
lean-body-mass-calculator.how: Enter total body weight and body fat percentage to separate total body weight into adipose tissue and metabolically active lean mass.
lean-body-mass-calculator.limits: Body composition calculations are only as accurate as the underlying body fat percentage measurement.
lean-body-mass-calculator.question: Why is tracking lean body mass important during weight loss?
lean-body-mass-calculator.answer: Monitoring lean mass ensures that caloric deficits cause adipose reduction rather than muscular atrophy.

running-calories-calculator.title: Running Calories Calculator
running-calories-calculator.description: Estimate calories burned while running based on speed, distance, and body weight.
running-calories-calculator.how: Select your pace bracket, enter distance in kilometers, and input your body weight to calculate net and gross calorie expenditure.
running-calories-calculator.limits: Wind resistance, running surface grade, footwear, and personal biomechanical efficiency alter real-world energy expenditure.
running-calories-calculator.question: Does running faster burn more calories per kilometer?
running-calories-calculator.answer: Energy expended per kilometer remains relatively constant across aerobic speeds, but running faster burns more calories per unit of time.

tdee-calculator.title: TDEE Calculator
tdee-calculator.description: Calculate your Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) based on activity level and basal metabolism.
tdee-calculator.how: Input age, gender, height, weight, and weekly activity profile to compute your maintenance caloric expenditure.
tdee-calculator.limits: Formulaic estimates provide an initial nutritional baseline that should be calibrated against body weight trends over weeks.
tdee-calculator.question: How does NEAT affect TDEE?
tdee-calculator.answer: Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis (walking, fidgeting, standing) can vary daily energy burn by hundreds of calories.

waist-to-height-ratio-calculator.title: Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator
waist-to-height-ratio-calculator.description: Assess cardiovascular and cardiometabolic health risks using the waist-to-height ratio.
waist-to-height-ratio-calculator.how: Measure waist circumference at the midpoint between the lower rib and iliac crest, then divide by total height.
waist-to-height-ratio-calculator.limits: WHtR is an anthropometric risk marker and does not evaluate lipid fractions or blood pressure directly.
waist-to-height-ratio-calculator.question: Why is waist-to-height ratio considered superior to BMI?
waist-to-height-ratio-calculator.answer: It directly reflects central visceral abdominal adiposity without confounding muscular mass with fat mass.

waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.title: Waist-to-Hip Ratio Calculator
waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.description: Assess body fat distribution and cardiovascular risk using the waist-to-hip ratio.
waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.how: Measure waist circumference at the narrowest point and hip circumference at the widest point of the buttocks.
waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.limits: Waist-to-hip ratio reflects anatomical distribution rather than absolute total adipose tissue mass.
waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.question: What health risks are linked to a high waist-to-hip ratio?
waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.answer: An android ratio exceeding 0.90 in men or 0.85 in women correlates with higher risk of hypertension and type 2 diabetes.

walking-calories-calculator.title: Walking Calories Calculator
walking-calories-calculator.description: Calculate calories burned while walking based on pace, distance, and body weight.
walking-calories-calculator.how: Select your walking speed, provide distance in kilometers, and input your body weight to determine energetic burn.
walking-calories-calculator.limits: Incline grade, pack weight, ambient temperature, and footwear mechanical cushioning alter final caloric cost.
walking-calories-calculator.question: How does brisk walking compare to running for fat loss?
walking-calories-calculator.answer: Walking burns fewer calories per minute than running, but places minimal stress on connective joint structures.

aquarium-volume-calculator.title: Aquarium Volume Calculator
aquarium-volume-calculator.description: Calculate rectangular or cylindrical aquarium capacity and estimated actual water volume in litres, US gallons, UK gallons, and cubic feet.
aquarium-volume-calculator.how: Select the tank shape (rectangular or cylindrical), enter dimensions, and specify the water fill level and substrate displacement percentage to calculate net water volume.
aquarium-volume-calculator.limits: Water volume estimates assume standard tank geometry and do not account for curved bowfront glass or external sump volumes.
aquarium-volume-calculator.question: How do substrate and decorations affect aquarium water volume?
aquarium-volume-calculator.answer: Gravel, rocks, and driftwood displace water, reducing the actual water capacity of your aquarium typically by 10% to 20% compared to empty volume.

barbell-plate-calculator.title: Barbell Plate Calculator
barbell-plate-calculator.description: Enter your target barbell weight and instantly calculate which plates to load on each side of the bar.
barbell-plate-calculator.how: Set your measurement unit (kg or lb), bar weight, and target weight to get an exact visual breakdown of plates to load per side.
barbell-plate-calculator.limits: Plate combinations use standard commercial denominations and assume equal plate distribution on both sides of the barbell.
barbell-plate-calculator.question: Why does the plate calculator divide the remaining weight by two?
barbell-plate-calculator.answer: A barbell requires identical weight on both the left and right sleeves to preserve balance, safety, and symmetrical lifting mechanics.

battery-charge-time-calculator.title: Battery Charge Time Calculator
battery-charge-time-calculator.description: Estimate how long it takes to charge a battery based on capacity, charger current, charge levels, and charging efficiency.
battery-charge-time-calculator.how: Input the battery capacity in amp-hours (Ah), charger output in amps (A), starting and target percentage, and estimated charging efficiency.
battery-charge-time-calculator.limits: Assumes a simplified constant-current phase; multi-stage charging algorithms like CC/CV will taper current in the top 10–20% of capacity.
battery-charge-time-calculator.question: Why does charging slow down near 100% capacity?
battery-charge-time-calculator.answer: Lithium and lead-acid chargers switch from constant current to constant voltage, reducing current to protect battery chemistry from overheating and voltage spikes.

dimensional-weight-calculator.title: Dimensional Weight Calculator
dimensional-weight-calculator.description: Calculate dimensional or volumetric shipping weight from package dimensions and compare it with actual weight to determine billable weight.
dimensional-weight-calculator.how: Select metric or imperial units, enter box length, width, height, and actual scale weight, along with your carrier’s DIM divisor.
dimensional-weight-calculator.limits: Different carriers use varying dimensional divisors (e.g. 5000 for metric international courier, 139 or 166 for domestic freight).
dimensional-weight-calculator.question: What is dimensional weight and why do carriers charge by it?
dimensional-weight-calculator.answer: Dimensional weight reflects parcel density. Bulky lightweight packages take up significant cargo space, so carriers bill whichever is greater: actual weight or volumetric weight.

electricity-cost-calculator.title: Electricity Cost Calculator – kWh & Appliance Cost
electricity-cost-calculator.description: Calculate appliance electricity use in kWh and estimate running costs from power wattage, daily usage time, billing days, and electricity rate.
electricity-cost-calculator.how: Enter the appliance wattage, average operating hours per day, billing period in days, and local utility rate per kilowatt-hour (kWh).
electricity-cost-calculator.limits: Assumes steady-state electricity consumption; cycling appliances such as refrigerators, air conditioners, and water heaters draw varying power throughout the day.
electricity-cost-calculator.question: How do I find the wattage of an electrical appliance?
electricity-cost-calculator.answer: Check the manufacturer label, nameplate, or power supply sticker on the device, which typically lists power in watts (W) or voltage and current (V × A = W).

fuel-cost-split-calculator.title: Fuel Cost & Passenger Split Calculator
fuel-cost-split-calculator.description: Calculate total trip fuel consumption, include road tolls and parking expenses, and divide the total trip cost evenly per passenger.
fuel-cost-split-calculator.how: Enter your route distance, vehicle fuel efficiency, fuel price, passenger count, and optional toll and parking costs.
fuel-cost-split-calculator.limits: Fuel consumption estimates assume consistent driving conditions and do not reflect elevation changes, heavy traffic, or aggressive driving.
fuel-cost-split-calculator.question: How do I calculate fuel split if some passengers travel only part of the route?
fuel-cost-split-calculator.answer: Compute each segment separately based on that leg’s distance and the passengers present, or split total costs proportionally by individual mileage.

schengen-90-180-day-calculator.title: Schengen 90/180 Day Calculator
schengen-90-180-day-calculator.description: Track short-stay visa-free travel days in the Schengen Area according to the official 90 days within any 180-day rolling rule.
schengen-90-180-day-calculator.how: Enter your evaluation reference date and add past or planned trips with entry and exit dates to check compliance and remaining days.
schengen-90-180-day-calculator.limits: This calculator evaluates the standard Schengen 90/180-day rule for non-EU/EEA passport holders and does not track national long-stay visas or residence permits.
schengen-90-180-day-calculator.question: How is the rolling 180-day Schengen window calculated?
schengen-90-180-day-calculator.answer: On any single calendar day, look back exactly 180 days; the total number of days spent inside the Schengen Area during that window must never exceed 90.

tire-size-calculator.title: Tire Size Calculator
tire-size-calculator.description: Compare original and replacement tire sizes including diameter, sidewall height, circumference, revolutions per mile/km, and speedometer error.
tire-size-calculator.how: Enter the width, aspect ratio, and rim diameter for both your existing and new tires, along with a reference driving speed.
tire-size-calculator.limits: Tire dimensions are calculated according to industry standard nominal sizing; actual mounted tread width and diameter vary slightly by manufacturer and wheel rim width.
tire-size-calculator.question: How much tire size difference is safe for a speedometer?
tire-size-calculator.answer: Most automotive technicians recommend keeping the total tire diameter difference within ±3% of the factory tire to avoid significant speedometer distortion and ABS/traction control errors.

unit-price-calculator.title: Unit Price Calculator
unit-price-calculator.description: Compare two products or package sizes by price per unit and instantly find the best value option and your percentage savings.
unit-price-calculator.how: Enter the total price and quantity/volume for Option A and Option B using the same unit of measure (e.g. grams, kilograms, liters, or pieces).
unit-price-calculator.limits: Unit pricing evaluates direct cost per volume or weight; it does not factor in bulk storage limitations, product expiration dates, or minimum spend thresholds.
unit-price-calculator.question: How do I compare items sold in different units like grams and kilograms?
unit-price-calculator.answer: Convert both items into the same common unit before calculating; for example, convert 500 grams into 0.5 kilograms so both unit prices are measured per kilogram.

website-worth-calculator.title: Website Worth Calculator
website-worth-calculator.description: Estimate website market valuation from traffic, monthly revenue, and profit metrics using standard earnings multiples.
website-worth-calculator.how: Enter the website URL to scan public technical signals, then enter monthly visitor volume, gross revenue, and net profit to compute a market value range.
website-worth-calculator.limits: Provides indicative valuation multiples based on normalized earnings; actual transactions depend on niche, churn, customer acquisition channels, and verified financials.
website-worth-calculator.question: What multiple of profit is typically used to value an online business?
website-worth-calculator.answer: Content, e-commerce, and SaaS websites typically sell for 24× to 40× monthly net profit (or 2.0× to 3.5× annual profit), adjusted for growth, defensibility, and risk.

cubic-yard-calculator.note: Compaction, settlement, excavation swell and supplier minimum quantities are not automatically included.

roofing-shingle-calculator.note: One roofing square is 100 square feet. Product coverage varies. Ridge caps, starter shingles, flashing, underlayment and accessories are separate.

rafter-length-calculator.note: Geometry only. Ridge-board deductions, birdsmouth and plumb cuts, structural sizing, trusses and code requirements are excluded.

stud-calculator.note: Openings, corners, intersections, backing, fire blocking, headers and local framing details can require additional lumber.

drywall-mud-calculator.note: Coverage depends on board arrangement, coats, corner beads, texture, taping method and product. Use your manufacturer’s coverage figure.

span.help: Outside-to-outside horizontal span of a symmetrical gable roof.

wallHeight.label: Wall height (feet)
wallHeight.help: Reference height above the floor or ground datum.

roof-ridge-height-calculator.note: Geometry only. Excludes structural sizing, ridge-board thickness, overhangs, cuts, ceiling build-up, loads and local code requirements.

fascia-replacement-cost-calculator.note: No local prices are supplied. Rot, soffits, gutters, scaffolding, paint, permits, taxes, access and structural repairs are excluded unless included in your rates.

ppi-calculator.note: Image PPI measures pixels per printed inch. Printer DPI measures physical ink or toner dots and is a different measurement.

shed-ramp-angle-calculator.note: Geometry only. This does not check accessibility rules or building codes. Equipment clearance, traction and weather affect safe use.

netQuantity.label: Net material quantity
netQuantity.help: Use one consistent unit: area, length, pieces or other material units.

construction-material-waste-calculator.note: Cuts, patterns, layout and site damage change waste. Purchases may need rounding to full packs, sheets or pallets. Keep the same quantity unit throughout.

soffit-fascia-calculator.note: Roof geometry, gables, hip returns, and rake boards may require separate measurement. Verify manufacturer panel dimensions and field measurements before ordering.

attic-insulation-payback-calculator.note: This is a simple-payback estimator and not a building energy simulation. Actual savings depend on climate zone, current insulation level, air sealing, HVAC efficiency, and occupant habits.

uniformLoad.label: Uniform load (psf)
uniformLoad.help: Total dead + live area load (e.g. 10 psf dead + 30 psf live = 40 psf).

joist-deflection-calculator.note: Simplified engineering estimate for simply supported, uniformly loaded rectangular members. Does not evaluate shear deflection, vibration, composite action, load duration, notches, holes, or building code compliance. Consult a licensed structural engineer for safety-critical framing.

velocity.label: Air velocity (FPM)
velocity.help: Typical branch ducts run 600–800 FPM; main trunks run 800–1,000 FPM.

hvac-duct-cfm-calculator.note: Calculates theoretical airflow from cross-sectional area and air velocity (Q = A × V). Does not size ducts from static pressure, friction loss, equivalent length, fittings, or fan curves. Use ACCA Manual D for complete HVAC design.

unitCount.label: Number of masonry units (bricks or blocks)

mortar-calculator.note: Estimates mortar volume based on standard unit bedding yields (5.0 ft³ per 1,000 modular bricks; 13.5 ft³ per 100 8x8x16 CMU blocks at 3/8" joints). Site-mix estimates assume standard Type N mortar (1 bag Portland cement to 3 ft³ masonry sand). Field waste and block coring variations can alter actual consumption.

concrete-block-calculator.note: Standard 8x8x16 nominal CMU blocks cover 0.8889 ft² each (1.125 blocks per sq ft of wall). Mortar and core fill grout are calculated for standard hollow 2-cell concrete masonry units. Structural reinforcement, bond beams, and engineered rebar schedules require project engineering review.

rainwater-harvesting-calculator.note: Theoretical yield uses the standard hydrology constant (1 inch of rain on 1 sq ft = 0.6233 US gallons) multiplied by roof runoff efficiency and first-flush diversion. Tank sizing models buffer capacity for user-specified consecutive dry days. Local potable water regulations and filtration standards must be verified before drinking use.

breedSize.label: Breed-size category
breedSize.help: Smaller breeds generally mature faster in year 1 but age more slowly in subsequent years.

dog-age-breed-specific-calculator.note: Human-equivalent age is an educational approximation. Genetics, individual weight, lifestyle, and veterinary care significantly influence biological aging.

currentWeight.label: Current puppy weight (lbs or kg)
currentWeight.help: Outputs will reflect the same unit entered.

breedSize.label: Expected breed-size category
breedSize.help: Small breeds reach full size much faster (9–10 months) than giant breeds (18–24 months).

puppy-growth-predictor.note: Growth curves are population estimates based on typical breed-size timelines. Nutrition, genetics, and health status cause individual variation.

factor.label: Life stage / activity factor
factor.help: Multiplies Resting Energy Requirement (70 × weight^0.75) by the life-stage factor.

cat-calorie-calculator.note: General informational energy estimates based on standard feline equations. Not a therapeutic feeding prescription, disease-specific diet, or medical weight-loss plan. Consult a veterinarian for personalized nutritional supervision.

doseMg.label: Caffeine consumed (mg)
doseMg.help: Typical 8oz brewed coffee is ~95mg; espresso ~63mg; energy drink ~160mg.

halfLifeHours.label: Estimated caffeine half-life (hours)
halfLifeHours.help: Typical adult half-life is 4–6 hours (average ~5 hours).

caffeine-half-life-calculator.note: Pharmacokinetic half-life estimate. Individual clearance rates vary with genetics (CYP1A2), pregnancy, oral contraceptives, smoking, medications, and age.

baselineHrv.label: Personal baseline HRV (ms)
baselineHrv.help: Your established rolling 7–30 day average HRV (e.g., rMSSD or SDNN).

currentHrv.label: Current HRV reading (ms)
currentHrv.help: Measured under consistent resting morning conditions.

hrv-baseline-deviation-calculator.note: Mathematical comparison only. Device sensors, sleep, circadian rhythm, and measurement posture affect readings. Does not diagnose recovery, fitness, stress, or health status.

totalKg.label: Powerlifting competition total (kg)
totalKg.help: Sum of best valid squat, bench press, and deadlift in kg.

wilks-dots-powerlifting-calculator.note: Uses published standard coefficients for DOTS and original 1994 Wilks scoring. Different federations or eras may use updated coefficients. For training and comparative analysis only.

options.fat-loss: Fat Loss / Cutting (35% P / 35% C / 30% F)
options.muscle-gain: Muscle Gain / Bulking (30% P / 50% C / 20% F)

bodyWeightKg.label: Body weight (kg, for protein density check)

macronutrient-calculator.note: Calorie conversion uses standard Atwater factors (4 kcal/g protein & carbs, 9 kcal/g fat). Protein intake between 1.6 to 2.2 g/kg is widely recommended in sports science literature for muscle preservation and synthesis.

running-pace-calculator.note: Pace splits and speeds are calculated from total elapsed time. Equivalent race times use Pete Riegel’s endurance scaling law (T2 = T1 × [D2 / D1]^1.06), which models aerobic fatigue across differing race distances.

hydration-calculator.note: Guidelines reflect National Academy of Medicine fluid intake standards (35 mL/kg baseline plus exercise sweat replacement). Food intake typically provides an additional 20–30% of total daily fluid volume.

one-rep-max-calculator.note: Submaximal rep-max formulas are most accurate when tested between 2 and 10 repetitions. As repetitions exceed 10, muscular endurance skews single-effort neuromuscular maximum estimates.

rental-property-cash-flow-calculator.note: NOI subtracts operating expenses from effective income and deliberately excludes mortgage principal and interest. Debt service is deducted afterward to estimate cash flow.

annualRent.label: Optional annual rent override ($)
annualRent.help: When greater than zero, this replaces monthly rent × 12.

rental-yield-calculator.note: Gross yield is annual rent ÷ property value. Net yield subtracts the entered operating expenses first; financing and taxes on your personal income are not included.

cap-rate-calculator.note: Cap rate equals NOI ÷ property value. NOI excludes mortgage/debt service, depreciation, income tax, and capital expenditures unless you deliberately include an allowance in operating expenses.

cash-on-cash-return-calculator.note: Cash-on-cash return compares annual pre-tax cash flow with initial cash invested. It excludes appreciation, principal paydown, sale proceeds, and tax effects.

brrrr-calculator.note: Refinance proceeds, value, costs, rent, vacancy, and debt service are estimates. Lending approval, appraisal, seasoning rules, taxes, reserves, and unplanned repairs are not modeled.

fix-and-flip-profit-calculator.note: This planning estimate excludes tax and legal conclusions. Actual costs can change with project scope, time, financing terms, inspections, market conditions, and transaction details.

short-term-rental-break-even-calculator.note: Excludes income taxes, debt service principal paydown, seasonality fluctuations, and local short-term rental compliance fees.

house-hacking-effective-rent-calculator.note: Cash-flow planning calculation. Excludes principal accumulation, property appreciation, income taxes, and transaction closing costs.

cached.label: Cached input tokens per request
cached.help: Must be part of the entered input-token count.

ai-token-calculator.note: Token counts are entered directly. Character-to-token ratios vary by tokenizer, language, and model, so this tool does not claim an exact text conversion.

llm-api-cost-calculator.note: All prices are editable planning inputs. Verify current provider and model rates, billing units, cache rules, batch discounts, and taxes before relying on the estimate.

gpu-compute-cost-calculator.note: This generic estimate uses the entered billable rate. Reserved capacity, startup time, storage, networking, CPU/RAM, taxes, and provider-specific rounding are not included.

cloud-hosting-cost-calculator.note: This is a provider-independent planning estimator, not an exact AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud bill. Enter rates that match your region and service configuration.

cdn-cost-calculator.note: Origin traffic is estimated as CDN bandwidth × (1 − cache-hit ratio). Real billing can count requests, cache misses, revalidation, regional tiers, and origin transfer differently.

startup-runway-calculator.note: When revenue meets or exceeds expenses, simple runway is shown as not applicable rather than infinity. Growth projections are scenarios, not forecasts.

saas-burn-rate-calculator.note: Gross burn is average expenses; operating net burn is expenses minus revenue; cash burn is the observed decline in cash. Financing and working-capital changes can make them differ.

ltv-cac-ratio-calculator.note: This uses ARPU × gross margin ÷ monthly churn. Cohort, revenue-retention, discount-rate, contribution-margin, and contract models can produce different LTV estimates.

cac-payback-calculator.note: Payback uses steady monthly gross profit and does not model churn, expansion, collections timing, sales commissions outside CAC, or the time value of money.

churn-impact-calculator.note: Gross churn is applied to each month’s opening customer base, then new customers are added. New customers affect net change but do not reduce the reported gross losses.

margin.label: Profitability margin (%)
margin.help: Use either EBITDA or free-cash-flow margin consistently.

rule-of-40-calculator.note: The score is growth plus the selected profitability margin. It is a screening heuristic—not proof that a company is healthy, valuable, or suitable for investment.

net-revenue-retention-calculator.note: NRR requires positive starting recurring revenue. Keep the period and revenue definition consistent and exclude new-customer revenue from expansion.

loss.label: Portfolio loss (%)
loss.help: Used when start value is zero.

current.label: Optional current value ($)
current.help: When a start value is entered, this value determines the drawdown.

drawdown-recovery-calculator.note: A loss and an equal percentage gain do not cancel because the gain starts from a smaller base. A 100% loss has no finite percentage recovery and is shown as not applicable.

meeting-roi-calculator.note: Cost estimates model direct loaded employee compensation and exclude preparation, follow-up, room, software, and opportunity costs. Value created is an entered planning assumption, not an accounting fact.

ev-vs-gas-break-even-calculator.note: Excludes financing, taxes, depreciation, insurance, and tax incentives. Real-world efficiency varies with weather, speed, and driving style.

fuelEnergyPrice.label: Furnace fuel price per kWh equivalent ($)

heat-pump-vs-furnace-cost-calculator.note: Excludes cooling benefits, auxiliary resistive heat, incentives, and equipment replacement lifespans. Fuel price uses thermal kWh equivalent.

job-offer-total-comp-calculator.note: Equity values and bonuses are planning estimates. Stock price volatility, tax withholding, vesting cliffs, and non-guaranteed bonuses can alter actual take-home compensation.

lumpsum-investment-calculator.note: Compounding projections assume continuous reinvestment of all dividends and capital returns. Real purchasing power calculates future value discounted by constant inflation. Taxes and investment management expenses are excluded.

savings-goal-calculator.note: Calculation uses ordinary annuity compounding where monthly savings deposits earn interest at the end of each monthly period. Starting capital compounds across the full duration.

monthlyDebts.label: Monthly recurring debts ($)
monthlyDebts.help: Auto loans, student debt, credit card minimums

targetFrontEndDtiPercent.label: Front-end DTI cap (%)
targetFrontEndDtiPercent.help: Housing payment as % of gross monthly income (standard: 28%)

targetBackEndDtiPercent.label: Back-end DTI cap (%)
targetBackEndDtiPercent.help: Total debt obligations as % of gross income (standard: 36%)

mortgage-affordability-calculator.note: Affordability is constrained by the more restrictive of the front-end (housing ratio) or back-end (total debt ratio) standard underwriting limits. Private mortgage insurance (PMI) and HOA fees are not included.

fixedCosts.label: Total periodic fixed costs ($)
fixedCosts.help: Rent, base salaries, insurance, software leases

break-even-calculator.note: Contribution margin represents revenue remaining after variable unit costs to cover fixed operational overhead. Margin of safety indicates the percentage sales can drop before the operation incurs a loss.

profit-margin-markup-calculator.note: Margin is gross profit divided by selling price, while markup is gross profit divided by cost. Margin can never reach or exceed 100% for positive cost goods.

parentPrefix.label: Parent prefix length (/0–/128)
parentPrefix.help: Leading routing prefix (e.g. /48 site allocation or /56 delegation).

subnetPrefix.label: Subnet prefix length (/0–/128)
subnetPrefix.help: Target subnet size (e.g. /64 standard LAN or /128 single address).

ipv6-subnet-calculator.note: IPv6 prefix mathematics uses exact 128-bit integer capacity. A /64 prefix is the standard LAN allocation recommended by RFC 4291/7217 for SLAAC autoconfiguration, providing 18.4 quintillion addresses per subnet. Subnet counts and address capacities exceeding 2^53 are computed using exact BigInt arithmetic.

tcp-udp-port-range-calculator.note: Calculates the inclusive numeric port span across the 16-bit port number space (0–65535). Categorization identifies standard IANA port segments: System/Well-Known (0–1023), User/Registered (1024–49151), and Dynamic/Private/Ephemeral (49152–65535). Numeric counting does not test port accessibility or protocol state.

cidrList.label: IPv4 CIDR networks
cidrList.help: Enter one IPv4 CIDR prefix per line (e.g. 192.168.0.0/25).

cidr-summarization-calculator.note: Exact IPv4 route aggregation normalizes subnets to network boundaries, eliminates contained redundant networks, and iteratively merges adjacent equal-sized sibling blocks where the parent exactly covers the address space. Non-sibling or misaligned networks are never combined into wider blocks that cover unsupplied addresses.

ipAddress.label: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6)
ipAddress.help: Evaluated locally without external network probes or DNS resolution.

ip-address-classifier.note: Classification evaluates IP syntax against authoritative IANA Special-Purpose Address Registries (RFC 6890, RFC 1918, RFC 4291, RFC 3927). A classification of Global Unicast indicates syntactic public allocation; reachability depends on network topology and firewall configurations. No network connections are initiated.

common-port-service-lookup.note: Searches a curated local reference of standardized and commonly observed service port assignments. If no match is found, the lookup explicitly states that no common entry exists rather than estimating or inventing a service. Service assignment does not indicate an active listener on your local machine.

url.label: Target URL
url.help: Must be an absolute URL including scheme (e.g. https://).

url-parser.note: URL parsing conforms to the WHATWG URL Standard implemented by modern web browsers. Relative paths or missing protocols produce an explicit invalid input alert rather than assuming an arbitrary default domain. Parameter parsing decodes percent-encoded query keys and values.

cdr-print-readiness-checker.note: Guided preflight checklist for CorelDRAW files based on user-verified preparation conditions. Browser inspection cannot reliably decode proprietary CorelDRAW binary document trees; this tool ensures critical print requirements (bleed, CMYK, curves, DPI, overprint) are systematically reviewed before sending files to a commercial printer.

responsive-srcset-generator.note: Generates standards-compliant HTML snippets for responsive web images. Responsive srcset variants improve Core Web Vitals and LCP scores. Image asset generation should be completed in your image pipeline or CDN.

yaml-json-converter.note: Bidirectional conversion is processed purely locally in the browser with no server roundtrips. Custom application tags and circular object references are not supported in standard JSON.

uuid-generator-validator.note: UUID generation uses the Web Crypto API for cryptographically secure pseudorandomness. UUID v7 encodes millisecond Unix epoch timestamps in the high bits for sortable database primary keys.

utm.invalidUrl: Please enter a valid starting URL (for example, https://example.com).

cement.title: Nominal mix inputs
cement.note: The 1.54 dry-volume factor and 1,440 kg/m³ cement bulk density are planning assumptions, not a verified mix design.

sand.title: Rectangular volume and supplier units
sand.note: Bulk density, bag mass, and lawful vehicle payload vary by material condition and supplier; confirm all three before ordering.

paint.title: Room surfaces and product coverage
paint.note: Coverage is product- and surface-specific. Openings are deducted from wall area; the optional ceiling is added separately.

tile.title: Fixed-orientation rectangular tile grid
tile.note: The grid does not optimize rotation, patterns, obstacles, or offcut reuse. Box count uses the entered package quantity.

steel.title: Ideal solid steel section
steel.note: The I-section is a sharp-edged planning model with one uniform flange/web thickness and clear web height. Use manufacturer tables for rolled profiles.

roofPitch.heading: Roof slope dimensions
roofPitch.note: Use the same unit for rise and run. Results describe geometry only, not structural adequacy.

stairStringer.heading: Stair dimensions (inches)
stairStringer.note: Planning geometry only. Codes, landings, headroom and stringer design vary.

deckBoard.heading: Deck and actual board dimensions
deckBoard.note: Rows include gaps between boards. Stock pieces assume each row is cut independently with no cross-row offcut reuse.

fence.heading: Fence layout
fence.note: This is a straight-run planning lower bound. Exact corner legs and gate positions need a segmented layout takeoff.

drywall.heading: Drywall area and sheet size
drywall.note: Openings must be smaller than combined wall and ceiling area. Fasteners, tape, and compound remain approximate planning allowances.

polymericSand.heading: Paver joint assumptions
polymericSand.note: The repeated-module model counts non-overlapping interior joints. Edge joints, cuts, compaction, and manufacturer coverage can change purchasing.

topsoil.heading: Topsoil coverage
topsoil.note: Weight varies materially with moisture, compaction and soil composition.

common.errorCheck: Enter valid positive numbers to compute.

bmi.heading: Calculate Body Mass Index
bmi.note: Adult BMI serves as a population screening metric and does not differentiate lean muscle from adipose tissue.

bmr.heading: Basal Metabolic Rate
bmr.note: Mifflin-St Jeor equation estimates calories expended to sustain fundamental physiological homeostasis.

bodyFat.heading: US Navy Body Fat Method
bodyFat.note: Circumference equations developed by the Naval Health Research Center provide standardized body composition estimates.

calorie.heading: Daily Calorie Requirements
calorie.note: Long-term body weight changes follow cumulative thermodynamic energy balance over weeks.

caloriesBurned.heading: Activity Caloric Burn
caloriesBurned.note: Calculations utilize standardized Compendium of Physical Activities metabolic equivalent values.

healthyWeight.heading: Healthy Weight Range Calculator
healthyWeight.note: Healthy weight thresholds correspond to standard World Health Organization adult BMI boundaries.

heartRate.heading: Heart Rate & Aerobic Target Zones
heartRate.note: Exercise training zones utilize the Karvonen formula and age-predicted maximal heart rate.

idealWeight.heading: Comparative Ideal Body Weight Formulas
idealWeight.note: Classic clinical formulas offer standardized comparative targets derived from historical demographic literature.

leanBodyMass.heading: Lean Body Mass & Composition
leanBodyMass.note: Lean mass encompasses all non-adipose anatomical structures including skeleton, muscular tissue, and organs.

runningCalories.heading: Running Energy Expenditure
runningCalories.note: Mechanical work in running correlates with body mass displacement against ground reaction forces.

tdee.heading: Total Daily Energy Expenditure
tdee.note: TDEE scales basal metabolism according to the PAL (Physical Activity Level) factorial method.

waistToHeight.heading: Waist-to-Height Ratio (WHtR)
waistToHeight.note: Keeping waist circumference under half of stature correlates with favorable cardiometabolic biomarkers.

waistToHip.heading: Waist-to-Hip Ratio (WHR)
waistToHip.note: WHO guidelines classify upper-body visceral android fat accumulation as an independent cardiovascular risk.

walkingCalories.heading: Walking Energy Expenditure
walkingCalories.note: Walking delivers low-impact aerobic conditioning with energy cost scaling linearly by distance and mass.

common.errorCheck: Enter valid positive values to calculate.

aquarium.heading: Tank dimensions & water estimate
aquarium.note: Calculates aquarium gross volume and net water volume accounting for fill level and substrate displacement.

barbell.heading: Target barbell weight & plate loading
barbell.targetBelowBar: Target weight cannot be lower than the bar weight.
barbell.note: Calculates standard plate combinations per side to reach the desired target barbell weight.

battery.heading: Battery charging specifications
battery.note: Estimates charge duration under constant-current assumptions accounting for charging efficiency.

dimWeight.heading: Package dimensions & dimensional weight
dimWeight.note: Compares package dimensional weight with actual scale weight to determine the carrier billable weight.

electricity.heading: Appliance power & electricity cost
electricity.note: Calculates energy consumption in kilowatt-hours and estimates running cost based on your local tariff.

fuelSplit.heading: Trip distance & fuel cost split
fuelSplit.note: Splits vehicle travel expenses fairly between passengers including fuel, tolls, and parking.

schengen.heading: Schengen travel dates & 180-day window
schengen.note: Tracks short-stay visa-free days in the Schengen Area according to the 90/180-day rolling rule.

tireSize.heading: Tire size specification comparison
tireSize.note: Compares dimensions, circumference, and speedometer variance between original and replacement tire sizes.

unitPrice.heading: Compare product sizes by unit price
unitPrice.equalPrice: Both options cost the same per unit
unitPrice.note: Compares unit prices between different product sizes to find the most economical choice.

websiteWorth.heading: Website traffic & revenue valuation
websiteWorth.scanFailed: Could not inspect this website URL.
websiteWorth.note: Provides an estimated website valuation range using traffic, revenue, and earnings multiple models.
